title: The Fast at the River of Ahava
reflectionQuestion: Ezra had told the king the hand of God was upon all those who seek him. He could not then ask the king for a band of soldiers. So they fasted at the river. The treasure was weighed out, and the road was kept, and they came to Jerusalem alive. What is it to walk a long dangerous road carrying something precious because you have spoken what you cannot now ask help to keep?
reflectionText: Ezra had told the king the hand of God was upon all them for good that seek him. He could not then ask the king for a band of soldiers. So they fasted at the river. The treasure was weighed out, and the road was kept, and they came unto Jerusalem alive. What is it to walk a long perilous road bearing somewhat precious because thou hast spoken what thou canst not now ask help to keep?
